title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Issuing the Opinions of the Supreme People's Court on Comprehensively Strengthening Intellectual Property Trial Work to Provide Judicial Protection for Building an Innovative Country
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Issuing the "Opinion of the Supreme People's Court on Comprehensively Strengthening Intellectual Property Trial Work to Provide Judicial Guarantees for Building an Innovative Country"

Fa Fa [2007] No. 1

All local people's courts at various levels nationwide, all military courts, all railway transport intermediate courts and basic courts, all maritime courts, and all courts of the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps:

The "Opinion of the Supreme People's Court on Comprehensively Strengthening Intellectual Property Trial Work to Provide Judicial Guarantees for Building an Innovative Country" is hereby issued to you. Please implement it diligently in trial work in light of actual circumstances.

January 11, 2007

Supreme People's Court

Opinion on Comprehensively Strengthening Intellectual Property Trial Work to Provide Judicial Guarantees for Building an Innovative Country

The Party Central Committee with Comrade Hu Jintao as General Secretary, proceeding from the strategic perspective of building a moderately prosperous society in all respects and accelerating the socialist modernization drive, clearly set forth the goal and task of building China into an innovative country in the "Decision of the CPC Central Committee and the State Council on Implementing the Outline of the National Medium- and Long-term Science and Technology Development Plan and Enhancing Independent Innovation Capability" and the "Decision of the CPC Central Committee on Several Major Issues Concerning Building a Socialist Harmonious Society." To fully leverage the trial functions of the people's courts and provide strong judicial guarantees for building an innovative country, the following opinions are hereby proposed with respect to comprehensively strengthening the intellectual property trial work of the people's courts.

I. Fully Recognize the Great Significance of Comprehensively Strengthening Intellectual Property Trial Work

1. Comprehensively strengthening intellectual property trial work will necessarily promote the building of an innovative country. The judicial protection of intellectual property by the people's courts, as state judicial organs, occupies a foundational position and plays a leading role in the overall national intellectual property law enforcement and protection system. The people's courts bear irreplaceable legal responsibilities and shoulder a great mission in adjusting intellectual property relations in accordance with the law, safeguarding the legitimate rights and interests of intellectual property rights holders, punishing crimes of intellectual property infringement, and maintaining the socialist market economic order. Comprehensively strengthening intellectual property trial work will necessarily advance the implementation of the strategy of strengthening the nation through human resources, and fully implement and embody the policy of respecting labor, respecting knowledge, respecting talent, and respecting creativity.

2. Comprehensively strengthening intellectual property trial work will necessarily establish a good international image for China. Comprehensively strengthening judicial protection of intellectual property is not only a practical need for China to participate in international competition and create a more attractive investment environment for introducing foreign capital and advanced technology, but also an objective requirement for China to fulfill its international commitments and establish a good international image. Comprehensively strengthening intellectual property trial work will necessarily better protect and attract foreign investment, safeguard and enhance the international competitiveness of Chinese enterprises, and further promote the opening up. By strictly sanctioning intellectual property infringements according to law, severely punishing serious illegal and criminal acts such as trademark counterfeiting and piracy according to law, and equally protecting the legitimate rights and interests of Chinese and foreign parties according to law, the people's courts will undoubtedly establish a good image of China's judicial protection of intellectual property.

3. Comprehensively strengthening intellectual property trial work will necessarily promote the building of a socialist harmonious society. Through intellectual property trials, the creative aspirations conducive to social progress can be respected, creative activities supported, creative capabilities brought into play, and creative achievements protected, infusing society with vitality and dynamism; it can promote and guarantee the establishment of a social credit mechanism, guide people to abide by promises, value credibility, maintain good practices, foster mutual trust, increase value identification and cohesion, and achieve social integrity, friendship, and fraternity.

II. The Guiding Ideology, Objectives, Tasks, and Basic Principles of Intellectual Property Trial Work

4. To provide judicial guarantees for building an innovative country, we must adhere to the guidance of Deng Xiaoping Theory and the Important Thought of Three Represents, fully implement the Scientific Outlook on Development, and in accordance with the requirements of building an innovative country, adhere to the principle of "fair justice, wholeheartedly for the people" and the theme of "fairness and efficiency," further intensify judicial protection of intellectual property, protect intellectual property according to law, safeguard fair competition, promote independent innovation, serve the opening up, and integrate judicial protection of intellectual property throughout the entire process of creation, management, and utilization of intellectual property, so as to provide strong judicial guarantees for implementing the national intellectual property strategy, building an innovative country, and constructing a socialist harmonious society, and strive to create a legal environment of fairness, efficiency, and authority.

5. The main objectives and tasks for providing judicial guarantees for building an innovative country are: intellectual property trial work to be comprehensively strengthened; the functions of criminal, civil, and administrative intellectual property trials to be fully exercised; the intellectual property litigation system to be continuously improved; the judicial protection system for intellectual property to be further perfected; the quality of intellectual property judges to be significantly enhanced; a favorable judicial protection environment for intellectual property, characterized by judicial fairness, efficiency, and authority, convenient and efficient rights protection for rights holders, inevitable punishment for infringers, and orderly circulation of intellectual wealth, to be basically established; judicial guarantee capabilities and levels for intellectual property to be markedly strengthened; and the judicial needs of an innovative country to be fully satisfied.

6. To provide judicial guarantees for building an innovative country, the following principles must be adhered to: First, uphold fair justice. Always regard fair justice as the soul and life of intellectual property trials, and through fair, efficient, and authoritative intellectual property justice, maximize the maintenance and realization of fairness and justice in the field of intellectual property. Second, uphold judicial uniformity. Strictly handle cases according to law, ensure the uniform application of legal norms and judicial interpretations in intellectual property trials, and strive to achieve coordination between judicial standards and adjudication results. Third, uphold equal protection. Equally protect the legitimate rights and interests of Chinese and foreign parties according to law, resolutely resist local protection and departmental selfishness, and overcome local blockades and industry monopolies. Fourth, uphold balance of interests. Correctly handle the relationship between protecting intellectual property and safeguarding public interests, and between encouraging technological innovation and encouraging technological application; while effectively protecting intellectual property, also prevent abuse of rights and illegal monopolies. Fifth, uphold service to the overall situation. Firmly establish a concept of the overall situation and service awareness, overcome the purely professional concept of handling cases merely for the sake of cases, and achieve organic unity between the legal effect and social effect of individual case processing.

III. Fully Leverage the Functional Role of Judicial Protection of Intellectual Property to Safeguard the Creative Vitality and Innovation Capability of the Entire Society

7. Severely punish crimes of intellectual property infringement according to law. Fully leverage the functional role of criminal judicial protection of intellectual property, use various criminal sanctions measures according to law, and bring into play the function of punishment and prevention of intellectual property crimes through penalties. For criminal acts involving intellectual property such as counterfeiting and piracy, further improve and unify the standards for conviction and sentencing, standardize the application of probation, and impose severe punishment according to law based on the circumstances and harmful consequences of the crime; while applying principal penalties according to law, increase the application and enforcement of fines; pay attention to adopting measures such as recovering illegal gains, confiscating criminal tools, destroying infringing products, and ordering compensation for losses to economically deprive infringers of their ability and conditions for recidivism; handle private criminal prosecutions for intellectual property infringement according to law, and effectively protect the right of victims to private prosecution; if during the trial of administrative cases, it is discovered that criminal acts that should be subject to criminal sanctions have only received administrative penalties or administrative processing, the court shall, while forwarding judicial suggestions to the administrative agency, promptly transfer the criminal leads to the public security organs for investigation and handling; if during the trial of civil cases, criminal leads are discovered and the conditions for private prosecution are met, the court shall inform the right holder that they may simultaneously file a private criminal prosecution; if a public prosecution should be filed according to law, the content suspected of criminal activity shall be promptly transferred to the public security organs for investigation and handling; after the transfer, if the civil case trial is not affected, the civil case may continue to be tried.

8. Properly hear intellectual property civil cases according to law. Pay attention to fully leveraging the leading role of intellectual property civil trials in protecting intellectual property and incentivizing independent innovation. According to law, hear technical intellectual property cases involving patents, technical secrets, computer software, new plant varieties, integrated circuit layout designs, etc., reasonably and moderately protect innovation achievements, and intensify protection of key core technologies with independent intellectual property rights that have breakthrough and driving effects on economic growth; according to law, hear trademark, geographical indication, and other labeling intellectual property cases, as well as various unfair competition cases, strictly regulate market competition order; according to law, hear expressive intellectual property cases involving works, audio and video recordings, etc., and promote the healthy development of copyright-related industries; according to law, hear intellectual property disputes involving computer networks, new technologies, and new types, and promote the healthy growth of emerging industries; according to law, hear foreign-related intellectual property cases, and equally protect the legitimate rights and interests of Chinese and foreign parties; actively protect traditional knowledge, genetic resources, and folk literature and art, and protect the rights of holders to informed consent and benefit sharing; scientifically and reasonably interpret the scope of rights according to law, correctly apply infringement determination methods, and strictly grasp the conditions for determining equivalents in patent infringement cases; cautiously determine well-known trademarks according to law; if the case falls outside the scope of determination or does not meet the conditions for determination, or if the plaintiff's infringement allegations cannot be established, no determination of well-known trademark shall be made; pay attention to two-way protection of parties in trade secret cases, and appropriately balance the relationship between freedom of career choice and trade secret protection; accurately determine the validity and liability of intellectual property contracts, strictly apply contract rescission conditions, and fully respect party autonomy.

9. Supervise and support administrative organs in law-based administration according to law. Effectively fulfill the function of administrative trials in judicial review of administrative law enforcement actions concerning intellectual property, supervise and support administrative organs in law-based administration, protect the legitimate rights and interests of administrative counterparts in intellectual property matters, maintain the administrative management order of intellectual property, and promote administrative protection of intellectual property. According to law, support administrative organs in sanctioning infringing acts; if an administrative organ applies for compulsory enforcement of an administrative decision and after review the conditions for enforcement are met, the court shall promptly render a ruling and proceed with compulsory enforcement; intensify judicial supervision over administrative inaction regarding serious intellectual property infringements, and urge administrative law enforcement organs to promptly stop infringements according to their authority; according to law, fulfill the duty of judicial review of intellectual property confirmation disputes such as patents and trademarks, and conduct comprehensive legality review of administrative actions in terms of fact-finding and legal application.

10. Strengthen trial supervision and case coordination in intellectual property matters. Smooth the channels for applying for retrials of intellectual property cases, strictly review cases that arouse strong reactions from parties and society according to law, and if judgments are found to be erroneous, promptly retrial and correct them; for clearly unreasonable petitions, properly carry out the work of settling litigation and petitions according to law and policy; strengthen trial supervision over administrative authorization dispute cases in intellectual property. For related cases with significant social impact, the trial courts should pay attention to communication, unify trial standards, ensure coordination of adjudication results, and if it is discovered that adjudication results may conflict, promptly report to the higher court for guidance and coordination; establish a reporting system for major intellectual property cases; for cases that are of overall importance, have significant impact, involve large amounts in dispute, or are new types without precedent, the accepting court shall promptly report the trial situation to the higher court; further improve the record-filing system for well-known trademark determinations.

11. Perfect the enforcement system for intellectual property cases. Establish a system for centralized enforcement of intellectual property cases; courts that handle a large number of intellectual property cases should designate a specialized collegial panel or group within the enforcement department to be responsible; if the person subject to enforcement fails to comply with a valid judgment ordering cessation of infringement and continues the original infringing act, in addition to the right holder being able to pursue civil liability according to law, the court shall coordinate with public security and procuratorial organs to pursue criminal liability for the crime of refusing to enforce a judgment or ruling according to law.

12. Improve the jurisdiction and acceptance system for intellectual property civil cases. Intellectual property civil cases shall in principle be heard at first instance by intermediate courts and above; in localities with a high volume of cases and heavy trial pressure, the higher court may report to the Supreme People's Court to designate certain basic courts to have jurisdiction over some intellectual property civil cases; strictly control the designated jurisdiction system for patent, new plant variety, and integrated circuit layout design cases; appropriately adjust the standards for level jurisdiction of intellectual property civil cases, expanding the scope of first-instance cases accepted by intermediate courts; intellectual property cases with general legal applicability significance may, upon decision by the adjudication committee of the lower court, be reported to the higher court for trial; if the higher court, upon review, finds that the conditions are met, it may directly hear the case; actively explore reform of the trial level jurisdiction for intellectual property cases; for pre-litigation provisional measures cases, after registration by the case filing department, they shall be immediately transferred to the business division responsible for intellectual property trials for review by professional trial judges, ensuring that a ruling is made within the statutory time limit, and that trial judges coordinate for immediate enforcement.

13. Increase the intensity of infringement compensation and civil sanctions according to law. Strictly apply the rules for damages in intellectual property infringement, implement the principle of full compensation, strive to reduce the cost of rights enforcement, and increase the deterrent effect of civil sanctions. According to law, appropriately reduce the burden of proof on the right holder for damages; if there is evidence that the infringer has committed multiple infringements at different times, it shall be presumed that there is continuous infringement, and the scope of compensation shall be determined accordingly; if the plaintiff, as a natural person, suffers mental damage due to the infringement, a reasonable amount of emotional distress damages may be determined according to the law upon the plaintiff's request; the reasonable attorney fees paid by the parties for the litigation shall, upon the parties' request, be reasonably determined taking into account factors such as the necessity, the extent to which all claims are supported, and the ratio between the claimed amount and the actual awarded amount, and shall be included in the compensation; consider the subjective fault of the parties to determine corresponding liability for compensation; apply civil sanctions according to law to punish infringers.

14. Correctly apply provisional measures according to law. For applications for preliminary injunctions or advance execution, property preservation, or evidence preservation made by parties before or during litigation, the court shall actively accept, promptly review, cautiously rule, and immediately enforce. Attach great importance to the timeliness of pre-litigation provisional measures; accurately grasp the substantive conditions for adopting provisional measures; for preliminary injunctions, while focusing on reviewing the likelihood of infringement, also consider the statute of limitations and the status of damage; for evidence preservation, while considering the likelihood of infringement, focus on the risk of evidence loss and the applicant's ability to collect evidence; scientifically and reasonably determine the security requirements.

15. Properly handle the determination of specialized technical facts. Pay attention to leveraging the role of people's jurors, expert witnesses, expert consultations, and technical appraisals in solving the problem of determining specialized technical facts in intellectual property trials. Pay attention to selecting experts with specialized technical expertise and certain legal knowledge who are widely recognized, and recommend them through the basic court in the city where they are located to be appointed as people's jurors; support parties in engaging persons with specialized knowledge as litigation assistants to appear in court to explain the specialized issues of the case, not limited by the time limit for evidence submission; for complex and difficult intellectual property cases, consultations may be sought from technical and legal experts in relevant fields; for specialized technical fact issues that are difficult to determine through other means, technical appraisal may be commissioned. For evidentiary materials such as publicly available publications formed outside China that can be preliminarily confirmed as authentic, unless the opposing party can effectively challenge their authenticity and the proffering party cannot effectively refute, there is no need to go through notarization, certification, or other authentication procedures.

16. Prohibit abuse of intellectual property rights. Accurately define the boundaries between the rights of intellectual property holders and the public, review and support parties' defenses such as prior rights, prior use rights, known technology, estoppel, fair use, and legitimate use according to law; stop illegal monopolization of technology and acts hindering technological progress, and determine invalidity grounds for technology contracts such as restricting research and development, mandatory grant-back, hindering implementation, tying, exclusive dealing, and prohibiting validity challenges according to law, so as to maintain fair competition in the technology market; prevent holders from abusing infringement warnings and abusing the right to sue, and improve the system for confirming non-infringement and for counterclaims for malicious litigation.

17. Increase mediation efforts in intellectual property cases. While applying adjudication methods to try cases, focus on litigation mediation in intellectual property cases, adhere to the principle of "mediate when possible, adjudicate when necessary, combine mediation and adjudication, and settle the case," and integrate mediation throughout the entire trial process to increase the rate of mediation and settlement with withdrawal; attach great importance to mediation in pre-litigation provisional measures cases; actively explore and summarize the experience of coordination in intellectual property administrative cases and mediation in criminal private prosecution cases; pay attention to leveraging the role of industry associations and professionals in communication and negotiation to help eliminate antagonism and resolve disputes.

18. Earnestly implement measures to serve the people judicially. Strengthen litigation guidance and explanation to enhance the parties' ability to participate in litigation and increase the credibility and enforceability of judgments. Compile intellectual property litigation guides; adhere to the open trial system; fully implement the system of informing parties of their rights and obligations; implement the system of prompting litigation risks; explore a system of guiding parties in evidence production; explore a system of investigative orders; for evidence preserved by state departments that parties cannot obtain on their own, and other evidence that parties truly cannot collect on their own due to objective reasons, the court may authorize the parties' attorneys to investigate and collect evidence; increase judicial assistance; for intellectuals with genuine financial difficulties and for especially distressed or near-bankrupt enterprises, reduce or exempt litigation costs; strengthen review of the qualifications of agents, and standardize citizen representation in intellectual property litigation according to law; regulate the relationship between judges and lawyers according to law, carefully review the litigation materials submitted by lawyers, and fully listen to the opinions of lawyers; strengthen awareness of trial time limits and efficiency, strictly review and decide on the suspension of litigation, and avoid causing litigation fatigue to the parties; improve the quality of judgment documents, so that the reasoning is clear and both winning and losing parties understand.

IV. Take Effective Measures to Enhance the Capacity for Judicial Guarantees in Intellectual Property

19. Strengthen the professionalization of the intellectual property trial team. Pay attention to selecting and cultivating intellectual property judges from among those proficient in law, with a good foundation in foreign languages, a background in science and engineering, and some trial experience, further improving the professional structure of the intellectual property trial team; pay attention to maintaining relative stability of the intellectual property trial team; establish a scientific and reasonable performance evaluation system, avoiding simply using the number of cases as a standard for measurement; increase training in professional skills for intellectual property judges; pay attention to improving the political quality and professional ethics of intellectual property judges, and effectively enhance the awareness of clean justice.

20. Improve intellectual property trial organizations. The Supreme People's Court, higher people's courts, intermediate courts that accept a relatively large number of intellectual property civil cases, and basic courts designated to accept intellectual property civil cases shall establish independent intellectual property trial divisions; other intermediate courts shall set up collegial panels for uniformly hearing intellectual property civil cases; functional departments such as case filing, criminal trial, administrative trial, enforcement, and trial supervision shall designate specialized collegial panels or professional personnel to be responsible for the review, trial, and enforcement of intellectual property cases.

21. Strengthen coordination and cooperation among functional departments for intellectual property protection. Strengthen business coordination and communication among the criminal, civil, and administrative trial departments for intellectual property; strengthen work linkage between intellectual property trial departments and case filing, enforcement, and trial supervision departments; strengthen information sharing and business exchanges between higher and lower courts. Pay attention to strengthening work coordination with relevant administrative law enforcement departments for intellectual property; strengthen work cooperation and mutual checks with public security and procuratorial organs in intellectual property criminal enforcement; strengthen information communication and mutual cooperation with comprehensive departments such as foreign affairs, commerce, science and technology, information industry, press, and propaganda in the protection of intellectual property.

22. Explore the establishment of a new mechanism for intellectual property adjudication. Proceeding from the need to enhance the overall judicial protection capacity for intellectual property, and with the objective of facilitating litigation for parties and court adjudication, optimizing the allocation of trial resources, simplifying relief procedures, and ensuring judicial uniformity, scientific countermeasures shall be formulated to improve the organizational foundation and rationalize the procedural operation mechanisms for intellectual property judicial protection. In-depth research shall be conducted and efforts shall be made to promote the improvement of dispute resolution mechanisms for patent, trademark, and other intellectual property rights confirmation.

23. Strengthen intellectual property judicial interpretations and legislative proposals. Further improve the quality of judicial interpretations, enhance their operability and transparency, unify judicial standards, and continuously refine the intellectual property litigation system; actively participate in intellectual property legislative activities, promptly submit legislative proposals to the legislative authorities and relevant state departments, affirm judicial practices proven mature and feasible through legislative forms, and promote the continuous improvement and perfection of the intellectual property legal system.

24. Conduct in-depth research on intellectual property judicial protection. In light of the characteristics of scientific, technological, economic, and cultural development as well as the realities of trial work, strengthen research on the application of law and the construction of litigation systems for new issues in intellectual property judicial protection; appropriately draw on beneficial experiences from international intellectual property protection, track new achievements in international intellectual property research, put forward scientific, reasonable, and practical countermeasures and suggestions, and promote the transformation of research results. Actively participate in international intellectual property legislative activities.

25. Actively issue intellectual property judicial suggestions. In response to problems identified in intellectual property work concerning local governments, enterprises, scientific research institutions, and others during the trial of intellectual property cases, promptly issue judicial suggestions to administrative authorities, industry associations, enterprises, and scientific research institutions, urging them to improve systems, strengthen management, close loopholes, and eliminate hidden dangers, so as to provide decision-making basis for local party committees and governments in formulating relevant policies. For intellectual property trends that may have a significant impact on China's scientific, technological, and economic development and the rise or fall of industries, timely warnings shall be issued to relevant parties to facilitate preparation for responses.

26. Increase the publicity of intellectual property judicial protection. In conjunction with the press release system of the people's courts, promptly release important news and typical cases in intellectual property adjudication; adhere to the principles of open and transparent adjudication, and in strict accordance with relevant regulations and requirements, promptly publish effective intellectual property judgment documents online; select influential cases, invite deputies to the People's Congress, members of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, representatives of industry associations and relevant departments, representatives of foreign governments and international organizations' offices in China, experts and scholars, and other representative persons as well as the public to observe court hearings, thereby enhancing the openness and credibility of intellectual property adjudication; increase external publicity efforts, deepening the comprehensive and objective understanding of countries around the world regarding China's intellectual property judicial protection system and its protection status.

It is the sacred duty of the people's courts to provide strong intellectual property judicial protection for building an innovation-oriented country. People's courts at all levels and all intellectual property judges shall continuously enhance their sense of responsibility and mission in doing a good job in intellectual property adjudication to provide strong judicial protection for building an innovation-oriented country, live up to their mission, work steadfastly, seek truth and pragmatism, forge ahead with innovation, strive to build a fair, efficient, and authoritative intellectual property judicial protection system, and create a favorable legal environment for building an innovation-oriented country.
